scope: The four apex terms across 8 instruments: 4 labour codes, 3 Telangana acts, IT Act (TDS).
method: Each term has ONE base concept plus per-instrument edits. Nothing is harmonised away; divergence is encoded, not resolved.
sign_convention: '- x' removes a requirement present in the constant (WIDENS the set). '+ x' adds a component absent from it. Substitution written '- x + y'.
provenance: Equations and statutory anchors from Labour_Codes_Definitions_Full_Comparative.xlsx (Definition_Algebra, Critical_Divergences). Machine predicates below are an encoding of that algebra and require legal review before operational use.

theta.name: supervisory wage dial
theta.note: The same clause, four settings: 1600 (TG LWF) / 15000 (Wage) / 18000 (IR, OSH).

employee.base: EMP_W = a = c AND d AND E AND work_nature IN W, apprentice excluded
employee.why_it_matters: Cannot be a single boolean on a payroll record. Must be a per-instrument derivation over (work type, wage level, engagement route, premises type).

variants.effect: Employed on wages by an establishment for hire or reward, closed work list.
Wages hook dropped; scope narrowed to industrial establishment premises.
Hire-or-reward dropped; open work list; unpaid mine workers pulled in.
Contractor route included - this single limb is why the PF/ESI contractor machinery exists.

overlays.h: For Ch.III/Ch.IV, membership gated at the notified wage ceiling
overlays.i: Above-ceiling employees STILL COUNT for coverage thresholds
overlays.j: For Ch.VII (Employee's Compensation), the Second Schedule set instead

variants.effect: Salary-only test. Residual limb makes coverage effectively universal-salaried. Adds a State-NEXUS rule: operations, not HQ, decide.

variants.equation: a - managerial - administrative - operational - (supervisory AND wage > 1600) - part_time - apprentice + (>=30 days in 12 months)
variants.effect: The worker-machine under the name 'employee', with theta fossilised at Rs 1,600 - below half of any current minimum wage, so it excludes every supervisor in the state.
No work list, no theta, no wage hook. Apprentice INCLUDED - the opposite of every other instrument in the stack.
The widest net is the undefined one.

employee.coverage_ladder: EMP_TDS >= EMP_PT(TG) >= SS_counted >= SS_member ; EMP_LWF(TG) narrowest

worker.base: w(theta, scope) = employed in <scope> on work in {manual, unskilled, skilled, technical, operational, clerical, supervisory} MINUS managerial/administrative capacity MINUS (supervisory AND wage > theta) MINUS apprentice
worker.why_it_matters: One formula, one constant differs. A Rs 16,500 supervisor flips membership across codes.

overlays.ch_iii: For the Trade Union chapter, ALL persons employed in trade or industry

employer.base: er = person who employs one or more employees, directly or through any person, on his own behalf or another's, plus four inclusion limbs {head of govt department, factory occupier/manager, contractor, legal representative of deceased employer}
employer.why_it_matters: Two irreconcilable concepts: RELATIONAL (who engages) versus FUNCTIONAL (who disburses). Deduction duties attach to the paymaster, engagement duties to the engager. These can be different persons.

variants.effect: IR alone writes 'employee or worker'.
The disbursement test IS the definition. No relational limb at all.

flags: DANGLING: Factories Act 1948 repealed by OSH Code

establishment.base: s = EST_W = place where industry, trade, business, manufacture or occupation is carried on, including a Government establishment. A PLACE. No headcount.
establishment.why_it_matters: The root legal object of the registration layer is not uniform across the four codes that share ONE common registration form. Registration interoperability rests on a definitional fault line.

edits.s1: + sector list: {factory, motor transport undertaking, newspaper, audio-visual, BOCW, plantation, mine, port/dock vicinity}
edits.s2: + branch MERGER: departments and branches, same or different places, = ONE establishment
edits.s3: x count(workers) >= 10 built INTO the definition (except mines/ports; hazardous-notified override to zero)
edits.s4: + factory-for-registration override: >=10 workers deemed establishment notwithstanding factory 20/40

variants.effect: Branch MERGER - all branches are ONE establishment for PF.
Establishment IS place x headcount. A 6-worker shop is not an OSH establishment at all.

variants.equation: b - industrial establishment or undertaking, own deeming with severable-unit rule
every BRANCH deemed a separate PERSON
variants.effect: Directly OPPOSITE to the SS branch-merger. The same multi-branch company is ONE establishment for EPF and N persons for TG PT.

flags: DANGLING: superseded by the 1988 Act - composed entirely of dangling pointers

variants.equation: the state's operative establishment concept - shop vs commercial establishment partition

wages.class: HARMONISED IN THE CODES, DIVERGENT OUTSIDE
wages.base: wg = {basic + dearness allowance + retaining allowance}, with the exclusion list, the 50% add-back proviso, and the 15% in-kind cap.
wages.why_it_matters: The four codes achieved identity here - this is the one genuine harmonisation success. Then PT, LWF, S&E and TDS each define their own base. Three live wage bases plus one dead pointer.

variants.effect: Identity. Only drafting variant: 'salary' singular.
Identity.
Identity.
Imports the TAX salary concept mid-definition. WIDER than code wages: perquisites are in.
flags: DANGLING: s.17 points at IT Act 1961, repealed; re-routes to IT Act 2025 ss.17/18
DANGLING: PoW 1936 repealed by Wage Code s.69(1); bonus limb points at Bonus Act 1965, also repealed

variants.effect: The SIXTH wage concept. Includes terms-based bonus, expressly excludes HRA.
The widest base.

component_matrix._legend: IN = expressly included, OUT = expressly excluded, COND = conditional, SILENT = definition does not address

factory.why_it_matters: Threshold, counting-set AND process-enum all differ. Near the thresholds the SAME payroll produces different counts per code.

variants.equation: premises x mfg x count(EMP_SS) >= 10(power)/20(no power) - {mine, hotel, restaurant, eating place}
premises x mfg' x count(WKR_OSH(18000)) >= 20(power)/40(no power)
